notizie.titolo: EIOPA updates RFR Technical Documentation to apply from 30 January 2027
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today an updated version of the Risk-Free Rate (RFR) Technical Documentation for the calculation of RFR term structures, which will apply from 30 January 2027.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA publishes its final advice on enhancements to insurers’ corporate disclosures under the EU Taxonomy
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today its Advice on the review of (re)insurance disclosures under the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act, following a request from the European Commission. EIOPA’s Advice aims to simplify reporting an improve the transparency and comparability of insurers' taxonomy disclosures.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA risk dashboard highlights market and cyber risks as key concerns for Europe’s insurers
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today its October 2026 Insurance Risk Dashboard. The main findings show that market and cyber risks remain elevated amid a geopolitically complex environment.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA’s risk dashboard underlines elevated market risk for occupational pension funds as geopolitical tensions persist
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today its 2026 October Risk Dashboard for Institutions for Occupational Retirement Provision (IORPs), highlighting market risk as a key concern for the European occupational pensions sector amid a complex geopolitical environment that continues to shape the risk landscape.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA staff paper sets out four-pillar approach to integrating behavioral insights into conduct of business supervision
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today a Staff Paper setting out a four-pillar framework to help supervisory authorities apply behavioral insights in their conduct of business supervision, with the ultimate goal of improving consumer outcomes.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA factsheet shows European insurers’ home and cross-border investments as well as exposure concentrations
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA collects and publishes comprehensive statistics on insurance undertakings in the European Economic Area. The factsheet published today complements regular statistics by providing further insights into insurers’ home and cross-border investments in securities.

notizie.titolo: European Supervisory Authorities set priorities for 2027
notizie.descrizione: The Joint Committee of the ESAs published today its Annual Work Programme for 2027, setting out its priorities for addressing cross-sectoral risks and strengthening coordination across the European Union's financial sector.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA seeks views on a more proportionate and outcomes-focused supervision of sales of insurance-based investment products
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA launched today a public consultation on its draft Supervisory Statement regarding a more outcomes-focused supervision of the sales process and pre-contractual disclosures of insurance-based investment products (IBIPs), within the existing regulatory framework.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA sets EU-wide expectations for the supervision of private equity-backed insurers
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today a supervisory statement on the authorization and ongoing supervision of private equity-related (re)insurance undertakings. The statement is addressed to national supervisors and aims to promote consistent, high-quality and risk-based supervision of PE-backed (re)insurers.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA names extreme heat as the key climate-related risk for life and health insurers and pension providers
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published a report today examining how climate change could affect life and health insurers and occupational pension providers. The report identifies extreme heat as the leading climate-related liability risk for the sectors.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA reports progress on its simplification initiatives
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today a follow-up to its approach to simplification. The new note takes stock of the progress made so far and sets out EIOPA's ongoing efforts and future plans to make regulation simpler and reduce unnecessary complexity across Europe's insurance and occupational pensions sectors.

notizie.titolo: ESAs call for vigilance over external dependencies, cyber threats and private credit risks
notizie.descrizione: The European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) have identified external dependencies, emerging technologies and private credit as key vulnerabilities for the EU financial system in their Autumn 2026 risk update.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA publishes its technical advice on minimum common standards for insurance guarantee schemes across the EU
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA has submitted its technical advice to the European Commission on minimum common standards for insurance guarantee schemes (IGS) in the European Union. The advice provides details on how to develop a targeted harmonisation of IGS.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA elects Stavros Konstantas of the Bank of Greece to its Management Board
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA's Board of Supervisors has elected Stavros Konstantas, Director of Occupational and Private Insurance Supervision at the Bank of Greece, to EIOPA’s Management Board.

notizie.titolo: EBA, EIOPA and ESMA propose amendments to bilateral margin requirements
notizie.descrizione: The European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) today published a final report on draft Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS), proposing to simplify the bilateral margin requirements of the European Commission’s Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/2251.

notizie.titolo: EBA, EIOPA and ESMA call for enhanced governance and consistent supervision to mitigate ICT risks from frontier AI models in the EU financial sector
notizie.descrizione: The European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) today published a statement calling for a cross-sectoral, risk-based and consistent supervisory approach to mitigate the ICT risks stemming from frontier AI models.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA’s risk dashboard for occupational pension funds highlights persistent market risks amid geopolitically complex environment
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA released today its July 2026 Risk Dashboard for institutions for occupational retirement provision (IORPs), highlighting that persistent geopolitical uncertainty and evolving global market conditions continue to shape the risk landscape for the European occupational pensions sector.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA insurance risk dashboard shows broadly stable risk environment even as cyber and geopolitical risk intensify
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today its July 2026 Insurance Risk Dashboard. The main findings show that risks in the European insurance sector are stable at a medium level.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA publishes factsheet on European (re)insurers’ exposures to private credit and private equity
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA collects and publishes comprehensive statistics on insurance undertakings in the European Economic Area. The factsheet published today complements regular statistics by providing further insights into (re)insurers’ exposures to private credit and private equity.

notizie.titolo: Joint Board of Appeal dismisses appeal against the EBA
notizie.descrizione: The Joint Board of Appeal of the European Supervisory Authorities has issued a decision stating that an appeal brought by an individual against the European Banking Authority is inadmissible.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA completes Solvency II Review mandate with final guidelines and draft technical standards before revised framework takes effect early next year
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today a total of eight sets of guidelines and draft technical standards relating to the review of the Solvency II framework. With today’s publications, EIOPA has delivered all the legal instruments it was mandated to develop under the review.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA publishes seven guidelines and draft technical standards related to the IRRD
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today altogether seven instruments related to the implementation of the Insurance Recovery and Resolution Directive (IRRD). The package includes four guidelines and three draft regulatory technical standards (RTS).

notizie.titolo: EIOPA launches consultation on IRRD draft technical standards covering the valuation of (re)insurers in the context of resolution
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA has launched two consultations today on policy instruments related to the implementation of the IRRD. Today’s consultations propose draft technical standards covering the valuation of (re)insurers and groups for the purposes of resolution.

notizie.titolo: The ESAs support ESRB warning on systemic cyber risks from frontier AI models
notizie.descrizione: The European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) welcome and support today’s warning from European Systemic Risk Board (ESRB) on the systemic cyber risks posed by frontier AI models.

notizie.titolo: EIOPA consults on enhancements to insurance corporate disclosures under EU Taxonomy for environmentally sustainable activities
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA has launched a consultation on proposed changes to insurance corporate disclosures under the EU Taxonomy framework for environmentally sustainable activities. EIOPA’s draft proposals aim to increase transparency, simplify reporting, and better align insurers’ Taxonomy-related reporting...

notizie.titolo: EIOPA peer review follow-up shows progress in product oversight and governance supervision
notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today its follow-up report to the Peer Review on Product Oversight and Governance (POG), assessing the progress made by National Competent Authorities (NCAs) in implementing recommended actions to strengthen the supervision of POG requirements.

notizie.descrizione: EIOPA published today its June 2026 Financial Stability Report, which assesses the resilience of the European insurance and occupational pensions sectors in a challenging economic and financial environment characterised by moderate growth, heightened geopolitical uncertainty...
